title: Heated Rivalry was such a phenomenon it was only a matter of time bef...
transcript: when I first heard that there was going to be a heated rivalry parody musical I did roll my eyes a little bit parody musicals typically are not really my thing and I find that most of the time they only really exist to capitalize on the IP that they are allegedly parodying especially with this show coming out less than a year from the show premiering it is hard not to look at it through that cynical lens and to be quite honest I really wasn't intending to go until I heard that it was being written by Dylan Marciello he wrote a show called Pop Off Michelangelo which I saw at fringe two years ago absolutely loved it it was probably my favorite thing I saw at fringe that year and so I was like okay maybe this one will actually be good and then you see who they have starring in it Jay Armstrong Johnson Jim and moon like they got some really great talent for this and so I actually went into the show open minded and ready to be won over and while I can't say that it completely sold me I did have a really good time Dylan is a fantastic songwriter and the songs here are really catchy and fun and it's also really funny there are of course jokes that will only make sense if you've seen the TV show but there are a good number of jokes that I think stand on their own as just good jokes it is not overly reliant on lines from the show to get cheap laughs or applause there are definitely moments where you could tell that this was rushed a little bit to the stage as there were quite a few times where I wanted them to really take the parody or the joke just one step further this show takes quite a few risks some of which pay off some of which don't there is a framing device not from the TV show that feels a little bit underbaked but on the flip side there is a moment of audience participation that I won't spoil but is one of my favourite moments of audience participation of the year it is so funny and works shockingly well for what they are trying to do and the performances are really great as well Jay Armstrong Johnson has a perfect Russian Ilya accent I joked with my friend after the show that this kind of feels like the role he was born to play and Jim and moon really capture Shane's endearing qualities they're both just really going for it which I appreciate listen at the end of the day it is still a parody musical but if you are a fan of heated rivalry and just looking for a fun night out this will certainly fit the Bill
reasoning: Reviewer had a good time and praises the songs, humor, and performances, but notes underbaked elements and admits it didn't completely sell him. Recommendation is qualified: good for fans looking for a fun night out.
keyQuote: while I can't say that it completely sold me I did have a really good time
